AMEND AND RECOMMIT TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the executive law, in relation to requiring annual fair
housing testing
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S7625

SPONSOR: KAPLAN
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the executive law, in relation to requiring annual fair
housing testing

 
PURPOSE:

This legislation sets up a fair housing testing program to identify
possible discrimination in the housing market.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 amends section 292 of the executive law by adding a new subdi-
vision 39 to define term fair housing testing, which means a covert
housing investigation to gather evidence of compliance with this article
for the purpose of comparing how members and non-members of protected
class who are otherwise similarly situated are treated.

Section 2 amends the executive law by adding a new section 295-a to the
executive law to direct the attorney general to conduct yearly fair
housing testing. The results shall be reported to the Governor and
Legislature. This section allows the attorney general to contract with a
non-profit organization to execute any or all portions of this fair
housing testing program.

Section 3 is the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

A recent NEWSDAY story has shed light on the fact that minorities are
exposed to bias when looking to purchase a home. This is unfathomable
and shows we are not removed from a time when this is commonplace. We
must act to enforce the laws already on the books, as well as to produce
new laws aimed at ending this shameful, and hateful practice. This
legislation seems to implement a third party run program of paired test-
ing. Paired testing is when two applicants have equivalent social and
economic characteristics differ only in terms of characteristics being
tested for discrimination such as race, sexual orientation, gender iden-
tity or disability status.  Paired testing is a tool used at the Federal
level and is called a critical methodology for assessing discrimination
in the housing market. This legislation seeks to employ an industry
funded, but independent third party paired testing program to help
prevent and to collect data on instances of bias in housing purchases.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

None.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

To be determined.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect on the ninetieth day.

BILL NUMBER: S7625a

SPONSOR: KAPLAN
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the executive law, in relation to requiring annual fair
housing testing

 
PURPOSE:

This legislation sets up a fair housing testing program to identify

Section 3 is the effective date.

exposed to bias when looking to purchase a home. This is unfathomable

must act to enforce the laws already on the books, as well as to produce
new laws aimed at ending this shameful, and hateful practice.  This
legislation seems to implement a third party run program of paired test-
ing. Paired testing is when two applicants have equivalent social and
economic characteristics differ only in terms of characteristics being
tested for discrimination such as race, sexual orientation, gender iden-
tity or disability status. Paired testing is a tool used at the Federal
level and is called a critical methodology for assessing discrimination
in the housing market. This legislation seeks to employ an industry
funded, but independent third party paired testing program to help
prevent and to collect data on instances of bias in housing purchases.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

None.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

To be determined.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect on the ninetieth day.
